subject: SafeHarbor SOC/SIG: request for SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts
content:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@safeharborsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: SafeHarbor Systems Security <security@safeharborsys.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/SOC2 follow-up — SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake we're collecting artifacts to verify provisioning and access control. Can you deliver the following by EOD next Wednesday (28 Apr)?

- SAML IdP metadata XML and sample SAML assertion (redacted)
- SCIM provisioning logs (delta + full) for the last 30 days in CSV or NDJSON; include timestamps and status codes
- A current RBAC snapshot showing roles -> permissions and a sample user role mapping (CSV)
- List of accounts with privileged/system roles (console admins, SRE service accounts) and when last used
- A short attestation/statement from your security team confirming least-privilege controls and periodic review cadence

If any of this needs special redaction guidance or a separate NDA, let me know. Happy to take an initial bundle and then request specific follow-ups.

Best,
Liam

---

2) Security will prepare a signed attestation PDF confirming our role-review cadence and least-privilege practice.
3) We'll redact any user PII (emails will be hashed/obfuscated) unless you need raw identifiers under an NDA.

Action owners & ETA:
- Jonas: coordinate bundle + upload to shared Drive by Wed 2026-04-22 EOD. (Attachments: saml_metadata XML, rbac snapshot)
- Karthik: export SCIM delta logs and include status/error codes (ETA: Thu 2026-04-22)
- Hannah: produce attestation PDF and guidance on redaction (ETA: Thu 2026-04-22)

Attachments (placeholders in this thread): redwood_saml_metadata.xml, rbac_snapshot_20260419.csv, scim_delta_20260401-20260419.csv, privileged_accounts_attestation_signed.pdf

Quick questions so we meet your needs:
- Do you want full event-level SCIM logs or just the delta record set?
- Any preferred format (CSV/NDJSON) or column set we should follow?

I'll start the export now and loop in security for the attestation.

Regards,

On Tue, 21 Apr 2026 at 15:04, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@safeharborsys.com> wrote:
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: SafeHarbor Systems Security <security@safeharborsys.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/SOC2 follow-up — SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

Thanks Jonas/Hannah — that plan looks good. A couple of clarifications before you redact:

- For SCIM logs we prefer event-level CSV (one row per SCIM operation) with these columns: timestamp, operation (create/update/patch/delete), resourceType, resourceId (user id), statusCode, actor (system/service account). If you need to hash resourceId that's OK as long as the mapping is retained for verification under NDA.
- For RBAC snapshot: please include a small sample mapping file that shows role_id, role_name, permissions[], and an example user -> role assignment row (we don't need the full user directory, just samples and the counts per role).
- Privileged accounts: list role, account id (can be hashed), last_auth_timestamp, and justification/type (human/service).

If you can upload to the Drive link you provided that works; otherwise a secure link or HubSpot attachment is fine. We have an internal ticket (HS-34892) tracking intake.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Liam
